Players Committee card image of [[4-LOM With Concussion Rifle (V) (ALT)]] (original printing), game text: “Permanent weapon is •4-LOM's Concussion Rifle (may target a character for free; target is power -1 until end of turn). Once per turn, may place a card from hand on bottom of Used Pile to draw top card from Reserve Deck.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/4lomwithconcussionrifle_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/8ba25cdb109b5da73d1397712bcc202e4a11ee69 8ba25cd] (7 January 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
